description: SvCarousel and SvTour in Svelte 5. The carousel is a sliding track with arrows, dot indicators, autoplay that pauses on hover and swipe support, sized by a slide count; the tour spotlights each target element in turn and steps through Back, Next and Done, with arrow keys to navigate and Escape to skip. Both portal and follow the theme.

faq.question: How is autoplay controlled?
faq.answer: autoplay takes the interval in milliseconds and 0 turns it off; the carousel pauses while hovered or focused and resumes after.

faq.question: How do I define tour steps?
faq.answer: Each step names a target element selector plus a title and text; the tour scrolls the target into view, dims the page around it and positions the card next to it.

faq.question: Can the tour be resumed later?
faq.answer: Yes. Bind the open flag and the current step; storing the step lets you reopen the tour where the user left off.
